 qemu (1:10.1.0+ds-5ubuntu2.1) questing; urgency=medium

diff --git a/debian/patches/series b/debian/patches/series

+++ b/debian/patches/series
@@ -31,3 +31,4 @@ ubuntu/pre-bionic-256k-ipxe-efi-roms.patch
 ubuntu/lp2121787/0001-target-i386-add-compatibility-property-for-arch_capa.patch
 ubuntu/lp2121787/0002-target-i386-add-compatibility-property-for-pdcm-feat.patch
 ubuntu/lp-2123828-fix-riscv-endianness.patch

diff --git a/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2131822-Add-v2-ubuntu-machine-types-for-arch-caps-handling.patch b/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2131822-Add-v2-ubuntu-machine-types-for-arch-caps-handling.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5c6eac8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2131822-Add-v2-ubuntu-machine-types-for-arch-caps-handling.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,146 @@
+Description: Add v2 ubuntu machine types for arch caps handling
+
+ - Across ubuntu releases before 25.10 questing we have to fix
+   (LP: #2131822) the handling of arch-caps. But doing so would
+   break existing guest, therefore this new behavior is gated
+   by newly created -v2 ubuntu machine types. These types and
+   handling needs to be known to subsequent releases to ensure
+   they can continue to host these guests e.g. in migrations
+
+ - Add questing I440FX v2 machine to be based on v10.1 instead
+   of v10.0.
+
+Signed-off-by: Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>
+
+Bug: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+bug/2131822
+Forwarded: not-needed
+Last-Update: 2026-01-14
+
+---
+ hw/i386/pc.c         | 11 +++++++++++
+ hw/i386/pc_piix.c    | 24 +++++++++++++++++++++++-
+ hw/i386/pc_q35.c     | 14 ++++++++++++++
+ include/hw/i386/pc.h |  3 +++
+ 4 files changed, 51 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
+
+diff --git a/hw/i386/pc.c b/hw/i386/pc.c
+index 64047c661a0..98741a9ef59 100644
+--- a/hw/i386/pc.c
++++ b/hw/i386/pc.c
+@@ -270,6 +270,17 @@ GlobalProperty pc_compat_2_6[] = {
+ };
+ const size_t pc_compat_2_6_len = G_N_ELEMENTS(pc_compat_2_6);
+ 
++/* Across ubuntu releases before 25.10 questing we have to fix (LP: #2131822)
++ * the handling of arch-caps. But doing so would break existing guests, therefore
++ * this new behavior is gated by newly created -v2 ubuntu machine types.
++ * These types and handling needs to be known to subsequent releases to ensure
++ * they can continue to host these guests e.g. in migrations
++ */
++GlobalProperty ubuntu_v2_override_arch_caps[] = {
++    { TYPE_X86_CPU, "x-arch-cap-always-on", "false" },
++};
++const size_t ubuntu_v2_override_arch_caps_len = G_N_ELEMENTS(ubuntu_v2_override_arch_caps);
++
+ /*
+  * @PC_FW_DATA:
+  * Size of the chunk of memory at the top of RAM for the BIOS ACPI tables
+diff --git a/hw/i386/pc_piix.c b/hw/i386/pc_piix.c
+index f21716952fd..f78855f0caa 100644
+--- a/hw/i386/pc_piix.c
++++ b/hw/i386/pc_piix.c
+@@ -500,6 +500,9 @@ static void pc_i440fx_init(MachineState *machine)
+ #define DEFINE_UBUNTU_I440FX_HPB_MAXCPUS_MACHINE(release) \
+     DEFINE_UBUNTU_I440FX_MACHINE_NAMED(release##_hpb_maxcpus, #release "-hpb-maxcpus")
+ 
++#define DEFINE_UBUNTU_VERSION_MACHINE(release, ver)                    \
++    DEFINE_UBUNTU_I440FX_MACHINE_NAMED(release##_##ver, #release "-" #ver)
++
+ static void pc_i440fx_machine_options(MachineClass *m)
+ {
+     PCMachineClass *pcmc = PC_MACHINE_CLASS(m);
+@@ -1156,6 +1159,17 @@ static void pc_noble_machine_options(MachineClass *m)
+ }
+ DEFINE_UBUNTU_I440FX_MACHINE(noble);
+ 
++static void pc_noble_v2_machine_options(MachineClass *m)
++{
++    pc_noble_machine_options(m);
++    m->desc = "Ubuntu 24.04 PC v2 (i440FX + PIIX, arch-caps fix, 1996)";
++
++    compat_props_add(m->compat_props, \
++                     ubuntu_v2_override_arch_caps, \
++                     ubuntu_v2_override_arch_caps_len);
++}
++DEFINE_UBUNTU_VERSION_MACHINE(noble, v2);
++
+ static void pc_oracular_machine_options(MachineClass *m)
+ {
+     pc_i440fx_machine_9_0_options(m);
+@@ -1176,8 +1190,16 @@ static void pc_questing_machine_options(MachineClass *m)
+ {
+     pc_i440fx_machine_10_0_options(m);
+     m->desc = "Ubuntu 25.10 PC (i440FX + PIIX, 1996)";
++    m->is_default = false;
++}
++DEFINE_UBUNTU_I440FX_MACHINE(questing);
++
++static void pc_questing_v2_machine_options(MachineClass *m)
++{
++    pc_i440fx_machine_10_1_options(m);
++    m->desc = "Ubuntu 25.10 PC v2 (i440FX + PIIX, + 10.1 machine, 1996)";
+     m->alias = "ubuntu";
+     /* if building for microvm this is false, otherwise true */
+     m->is_default = LATEST_IS_DEFAULT;
+ }
+-DEFINE_UBUNTU_I440FX_MACHINE(questing);
++DEFINE_UBUNTU_VERSION_MACHINE(questing, v2);
+diff --git a/hw/i386/pc_q35.c b/hw/i386/pc_q35.c
+index 36045325580..aa83bb529c1 100644
+--- a/hw/i386/pc_q35.c
++++ b/hw/i386/pc_q35.c
+@@ -363,6 +363,9 @@ static void pc_q35_init(MachineState *machine)
+ #define DEFINE_UBUNTU_Q35_HPB_MAXCPUS_MACHINE(release) \
+     DEFINE_UBUNTU_Q35_MACHINE_NAMED(release##_hpb_maxcpus, #release "-hpb-maxcpus")
+ 
++#define DEFINE_UBUNTU_VERSION_MACHINE(release, ver)                  \
++    DEFINE_UBUNTU_Q35_MACHINE_NAMED(release##_##ver, #release "-" #ver)
++
+ static void pc_q35_machine_options(MachineClass *m)
+ {
+     PCMachineClass *pcmc = PC_MACHINE_CLASS(m);
+@@ -983,6 +986,17 @@ static void pc_q35_noble_machine_options(MachineClass *m)
+ }
+ DEFINE_UBUNTU_Q35_MACHINE(noble);
+ 
++static void pc_q35_noble_v2_machine_options(MachineClass *m)
++{
++    pc_q35_noble_machine_options(m);
++    m->desc = "Ubuntu 24.04 PC v2 (Q35 + ICH9, arch-caps fix, 2009)";
++
++    compat_props_add(m->compat_props, \
++                     ubuntu_v2_override_arch_caps, \
++                     ubuntu_v2_override_arch_caps_len);
++}
++DEFINE_UBUNTU_VERSION_MACHINE(noble, v2);
++
+ static void pc_q35_oracular_machine_options(MachineClass *m)
+ {
+     pc_q35_machine_9_0_options(m);
+diff --git a/include/hw/i386/pc.h b/include/hw/i386/pc.h
+index 9a1b4cf40d4..2ee67d6426c 100644
+--- a/include/hw/i386/pc.h
++++ b/include/hw/i386/pc.h
+@@ -301,6 +301,9 @@ extern const size_t pc_compat_2_7_len;
+ extern GlobalProperty pc_compat_2_6[];
+ extern const size_t pc_compat_2_6_len;
+ 
++extern GlobalProperty ubuntu_v2_override_arch_caps[];
++extern const size_t ubuntu_v2_override_arch_caps_len;
++
+ #define DEFINE_PC_MACHINE(suffix, namestr, initfn, optsfn) \
+     static void pc_machine_##suffix##_class_init(ObjectClass *oc, \
+                                                  const void *data) \
+-- 
+2.45.2

diff --git a/debian/qemu-system-x86.NEWS b/debian/qemu-system-x86.NEWS
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..bc39f77
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/qemu-system-x86.NEWS
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+qemu (1:10.1.0+ds-5ubuntu5) resolute; urgency=medium
+
+  * Add Ubuntu -v2 machine types for old Ubuntu releases:
+    - pc-i440fx-noble-v2
+    - pc-q35-noble-v2
+    These new machine types have been added in Noble
+    to enable the arch-caps fix (LP: #2131822)
+
+  * Add Ubuntu Questing -v2 machine pc-i440fx-questing-v2
+    to fix the base machine type for Questing. Currently
+    the base machine type is 10.0 but it should be 10.1.
+
+ -- Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>  Wed, 10 Dec 2025 11:49:12 +0000
